newsitem.title: USA: University of Southern California $40 mln priced.
newsitem.headline: University of Southern California $40 mln priced.

text.p: Prager McCarthy & Sealy said Thursday it priced $40 million of California Educational Facilities Authority forward refunding revenue bonds for the University of Southern California, Series 1997, with a top yield of 5.90 percent in 2015.
Moody's Investors Service rates the issue Aa3 and Standard & Poor's Corp AA.
The bonds are dated 7/1/1997 and the first coupon is 10/1/1997 and the bonds are due 10/1.
The bonds are callable 10/1/2007 at 102.00, declining to par 10/1/2009.
